clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau tells a story about a family who moved off their septic tank. When workers opened it up, they found thousands of undigested vitamin pills sitting at the bottom.

His test for your own pills: drop one in a glass of water overnight. If it hasn't dissolved by morning, your body isn't absorbing it either, you're just paying for it to pass straight through.

Kevin Trudeau's view: a pill-form supplement that won't dissolve in water is money flushed away.

clips.end_words: food that has flavor or taste anymore
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says you can cut a modern onion all day and never cry, and eat a whole garlic clove without tasting much of anything.

His explanation: our soil has been drained of nutrients by decades of the same crops grown on the same land, heavy chemical fertilization, and the 1930s Dust Bowl, when 12 feet of topsoil blew clean away across the country.

That topsoil held most of the minerals food is supposed to carry.

Kevin Trudeau's point: we don't produce food with real flavor anymore, because we don't produce food with real nutrients anymore. Ever notice vegetables don't taste like they used to?

#kevintrudeau #foodtruth #soilhealth #wbdaily #healthtruth #realfood
